# Support

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](SUPPORT.vi.md)

## Choose the right channel

- **Documentation, CPU scripts, viewer bugs:** use a GitHub issue with minimal, synthetic test inputs and exact versions. See [issue templates](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/).
- **Sensitive vulnerabilities or leaked tokens:** contact **i.am@dangkhoa.dev** privately (see [Security](SECURITY.md)).
- **Synthetic face resemblance / identity removal:** contact **i.am@dangkhoa.dev** with the relevant `CORE:NNNN` or `AD:ADNNNN` code and optional `SOURCE/P1/P2/E1/E2` view. Do not upload your selfie through GitHub.
- **External datasets:** obtain source images from the relevant rights holder or an authorized data repository. The software works without any online dataset.

Supply your operating system, Python version, command, expected output and a redacted failure when opening a code issue. No service response time is promised.
